values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Prove exact thirty-six-case denominator: add_learner_joint_final_publish, remove_voter_pending_exclusion, governed_rejoin_from_stale_state, exact_retry_cached_result, learner_snapshot_catchup, leader_change_resume, missing_201_token, wrong_coarse_operation_kind, old_cut_mismatch, route_cut_mismatch, wrong_domain, wrong_certificate_generation, wrong_control_key, expired_certificate, revoked_certificate, unauthorized_overlap, unstable_raft_id_mapping, learner_lag, learner_divergent_snapshot, missing_snapshot, joint_old_only, joint_new_only, joint_union_only, final_cut_mismatch, concurrent_transition, conflicting_retry, removed_voter_endorsement, removed_voter_route, stale_rejoin_self_promotion, crash_every_phase, coherent_rollback_rejected, corrupt_journal_rejected, checkpoint_object_collision, capacity_n_plus_one_no_partial, state_symlink_rejected, lock_symlink_rejected. The positive add case must use a real authenticated #202 fourth-node learner and prove same-batch joint history; leader_change_resume must start from a durably committed joint cut; unstable_raft_id_mapping must preserve every old id and reject collision; governed_rejoin_from_stale_state must prove separate coarse Membership enrollment and promotion operations, exact sealed discriminators, and promotion consumption of both the local published enrollment generation and the still-current #202 admission generation; crash_every_phase must mechanically enumerate enrollment journal, local MembershipState preparation, stable-map preparation, before and after governed #202 admission calls and exact generation observations, enrollment checkpoint and result-cache boundaries, enrollment published-view flip, every voter-transition concrete reconcile, voter checkpoint/result boundaries, and final voter-view flip. The wrong_coarse_operation_kind case must emit a separate exact wrong_artifact_discriminator subassertion. Removal proof must bind before and after governed #202 exclusion calls and exact generation observations; no proof may claim private #202 staging or atomic cross-authority publication. The governed receipt proof must show that only the factory returns GovernedMembershipAuthorityReceipt, that operation digest, durable generation, and published state digest are exact, that read-only observation returns only the current exact receipt, and that forged, stale, mismatched-operation, mismatched-generation, or mismatched-state receipts fail before local publication.
